blocks.text:
Because the life of the Hereafter is described in Surah “Idha zulzilatil ard” in a way that settles in the heart, it is equal to half the Qur'an. The reason Surah “Qul huwallahu ahad” is said to be one third of the Qur'an is that the noble Qur'an is divided into three basic themes (events, commands and Tawhid). In this surah the belief in the oneness of Allah is stated in the most excellent manner. The reason Surah “Qul ya ayyuhal kafirun” is equal to one quarter of the Qur'an is that, if the noble Qur'an is divided into four themes — Tawhid, prophethood, laws and events — this surah speaks about Tawhid in a most lofty style. Some scholars say that the reason these surahs are said to be equal to half, one third and one quarter of the noble Qur'an is that by reciting these surahs one receives reward equal to half, one third and one quarter.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُ اَحَدُكُمْ اَنْ يَقْرَأَ اَلْفَ آيَةٍ فِيْ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ، قَالُوْا: وَمَنْ يَسْتَطِيْعُ ذلِكَ قَالَ: اَمَا يَسْتَطِيْعُ اَحَدُكُمْ اَنْ يَقْرَأَ اَلْهكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: رواة هذا الحديث كلهم ثقات وعقبة هذا غير مشهور ووافقه الذهبي:٥٦٧/١
blocks.tamil_translation: When the Prophet ﷺ asked, “Is any of you able to recite a thousand ayahs of the noble Qur'an every day?”, the Sahabah (RA) said, “Who is able to recite a thousand ayahs every day?” “Is none of you able to at least recite “Alhakumut-takathur”? (Its reward is equal to a thousand ayahs),” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) reports that Rasulullah ﷺ said.
